# Dr. Farhan Badshah — Consultant Physiotherapist & Rehabilitation Specialist

## Core Clinical Specialties
- **Sports Injury Rehabilitation**: Return-to-play programs for ACL, meniscus, ankle sprains, hamstring tears.
- **Musculoskeletal (MSK) Physiotherapy**: Joint, muscle, ligament, and tendon disorders.
- **Spine & Back Pain Care**: Sciatica, disc herniation, chronic lower back pain, cervical neck stiffness.
- **Neurological Rehabilitation**: Stroke rehabilitation, Parkinson's disease, spinal cord recovery.
- **Geriatric Physical Therapy**: Balance training, fall prevention, osteoarthritic knee care.
- **Post-Surgical Rehabilitation**: Joint replacements (knee, hip), arthroscopy, rotator cuff repairs.
- **Manual Therapy & Exercise Therapy**: Graded motor exposure, therapeutic exercise, kinesiology taping.
